messages.subject: hiphop paper out now
messages.body_plain:
The paper describing the idea behind the hiphop approach is out now!
It can be found here:
https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/1755-0998.13389
Alternatively ask for a private copy from one of the authors on ResearchGate:
https://www.researchgate.net/publication/350297674_hiphop_Improved_paternity_assignment_among_close_relatives_using_a_simple_exclusion_method_for_biallelic_markers

The citation is: Cockburn, A., Peñalba, J.V., Jaccoud, D., Kilian, A., Brouwer, L., Double, M.C., Margraf, N., Osmond, H.L., Kruuk, L.E.B. and van de Pol, M. (2021), hiphop: Improved paternity assignment among close relatives using a simple exclusion method for biallelic markers. Mol Ecol Resour. https://doi.org/10.1111/1755-0998.13389
